name: UK Companies House public data REST API (key)
tier_rationale: Government body, the UK companies registrar, with a documented public data API (A8 trusted); P227 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official register of UK companies, officers and persons with significant control; officer and PSC data are minimised to name, role and dates at parse time (P227 cond 4).

companies_house.description: Companies House REST API key (sent only as the HTTP basic-auth username, never in URLs)
companies_house.plan_hint: a key of a company/team account created under the corporate identity, never an analyst's personal account; legal records the plan (v3lum keys set companies_house --plan business) and the terms URL before it runs under the corporate profile (P227 cond 2)

public_data_api.title: Companies House public data API: company search, profile, officers, persons with significant control

terms.quote: Key-terms (A1): the key belongs to a company/team account created under the corporate identity (never an analyst's personal free account) on a plan whose terms permit internal business use; legal records plan and terms URL in the provider registry (key_plans / free_plan_business_use) before it runs under the corporate profile.

public_data_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P227 cond 2). Data under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (attribution in data_attribution). Research C0530: keyless 401 {error: 'Empty Authorization header'}. Documented limit 600 requests per 5 minutes per key (P227 cond 5). Batch p3-G10-1.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-1 (P227). A separate provider from companies_house (p2-G14-2, manual find-and-update links only) because the API needs the registered key 'companies_house' and a provider extension cannot declare keys (one key per provider); the owner may merge both once extensions can carry keys (core request in docs/backlog/p3-G10-1.md).
